&e[NPC] &cElle&f: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding!
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: I saw what happened! I saw everything!

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: This giant tentacle monster story is real?
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: I agree, let's get inside.
}}

{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &cElle&f: What a fight!

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: And we got all the Sulphur back!
&e[NPC] Ugo&f: But what exactly was that monster?

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign.
&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Especially if it's after our Sulphur.

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive.

&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, I would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there.
&e[NPC] Ugo&f: No hard feelings, I also judged you too quickly.
&e[NPC] Ugo&f: You too &7<player>&f, you and your friends fought bravely, we couldn't have done it without you

&e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'll also alert our Chief. Time to go.

&e[NPC] &cElle&f: Is anyone going to thank me?
}}

{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou finally retrieved the Sulphur.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lWhat took you so long?

&e[NPC] Ugo: &fA gian-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou even needed the help of those adventurers.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lDo you have no shame?

&e[NPC] Ugo: &fI didn't-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lLook at the time. You are late to your training.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGuards, escort my son out of the hut.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &7<player> &f&lI am in your debt.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI cherish Ugo more than anything else in this world.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lA father could not be prouder of his son.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMy mind is at peace knowing you are by his side.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMore importantly, I am glad he finally met someone he can consider his friend.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI taught him everything I could, but there are things only friends can teach.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI won't hold you any longer.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGood luck in your adventures.
}}
